testResults:
Added 3 unit tests to crates/jcode-base/src/hooks.rs:

1. parse_turn_end_followup_injects_on_block_decision — verifies {"decision":"block","followup_message":"continue the run"} => Inject, and whitespace-padded JSON also parses.

2. parse_turn_end_followup_continues_without_block_decision — covers empty stdout, whitespace, non-block decision, missing followup_message, empty/whitespace message, and malformed JSON => Continue.

3. parse_turn_end_followup_truncates_long_messages — a 20k-char message is truncated to FOLLOWUP_MESSAGE_LIMIT (8000).

Run: cargo test -p jcode-base --lib hooks
Result: 11 passed; 0 failed (includes pre-existing observer + pre_tool gate tests, confirming no regressions).

The turn-level injection path is additionally verified by the app-core lib test suite (running in parallel).
